correctness.rationale: PASS: For every n>=2, the graph P_n square K3 has degree-three boundary and degree-four interior, with ties at interior sites retaining incumbents. Its binary majority update can be encoded in 64 paired two-time column symbols; six local two-direction update equalities define B(a,b) and H(a,b,c). The bijection between n-column two-step fixed pairs and 4096-state transfer paths gives P_n=v_P T_P^{n-2}w_P, with 64-state fixed Q analogue. The precise SOURCE verify.py local majority code and annihilator were inspected; an independently written sparse integer transfer reconstruction reproduced 9812 paired arcs/200 starts and 182 fixed arcs/16 starts, checked ZERO in all 4096 coordinates of the degree-nine left annihilator and all 64 coordinates of the degree-four left annihilator, then P2..P10=22,62,232,800,3028,11414,43096,162746,614878 and Q2..Q6=4,8,22,62,178. This finite exhaustive matrix certificate plus exact recurrence establishes all n, not extrapolated sequence fits. Symmetric-threshold two-time energy with W=A+I/2 excludes recurrent higher periods; factor isolation gives the unique dominant quartic base 3.778651974588... >3, and exact simple-pole residues yield stated P,Q,C asymptotics.
